subject.title: fix: derive heap pressure thresholds from V8 heap limit

question: Should 60% warning and 75% critical of V8’s effective heap limit become the default gateway memory-pressure policy, with this PR selected over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104681?
rationale: The V8-relative boundary fixes the reported root cause, but the percentages change availability-sensitive defaults for ordinary installations and two competing implementations remain open; repository history does not establish these margins as an existing contract.

options.title: Adopt this candidate
options.body: Approve the 60%/75% policy, require real gateway proof, land this better-tested candidate, and then close the competing PR.

options.title: Adopt the competing candidate
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104681 only if its proof gap is resolved and maintainers prefer its implementation.

options.title: Revise the margins
options.body: Keep the V8-relative architecture but change the percentages and corresponding tests before landing either candidate.
